ns2:section.sectionText: Location: Trelease Third Floor Lounge, Florida Avenue Residence Hall. This course is a special exploration course intended to engage women undergraduates majoring in mathematics, science, and engineering curricula in museum work in the Champaign-Urbana area. Class meetings will take place at the WIMSE living/learning community and a local museum. This course is restricted to students living in the WIMSE (Women in Mathematics, Science, and Engineering) living/learning community. Instructor permission required: Donna Michelle Hinn (hinn@uiuc.edu). See section description at http://www.lis.uiuc.edu/oc/courses/catalog/catalog.html
